checkpoints.description: [1/4] Plan: dependency-free N-body orbital sandbox with leapfrog core, 4 scenarios, terminal renderer, CLI, CSV export and regression tests

impact_assessment.why: The user asked for a new project from scratch; AIKit's projects/ is the intended home and a self-contained physics toy gives a runnable, testable result.
impact_assessment.benefits: Zero-dependency, local-first, educational, visually immediate, and fully unit-testable through a pure simulation core.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: new project, no existing contract to break; dependency: none, Python standard library only; concurrency: none, single-process CLI with no shared state; state: output is stateless and CSV export is user-owned
impact_assessment.mitigation: ASCII fallback plus color detection, capped viewport sizes, symplectic integrator, a known figure-eight benchmark, and a four-milestone scope.

checkpoints.description: [4/4] Built Orrery with leapfrog N-body core, four scenarios, ASCII/ANSI renderer, CLI (list/info/snapshot/run/export), README, ADRs; 40 tests pass; 4/4 gates pass; checklists: passed

handoff.evidence: python -m unittest discover -s tests -t . and python aikit.py check orrery

[1/2] Plan: v2 enhancements with Braille trails, Pythagorean chaos scenario, custom JSON scenario loader, golden frame tests, JSON export, and CI workflow

impact_assessment.why: Expand Orrery with higher visual resolution, user scenarios, and full CI coverage.
impact_assessment.benefits: Subcell Braille rendering gives smooth orbits; custom JSON worlds enable user scenarios; CI guarantees multi-platform stability.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: no breaking changes to CLI or sim; dependency: zero external runtime deps; concurrency: none; state: deterministic outputs.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Backward-compatible flags (--no-braille, --ascii), strict schema validation for custom files, golden tests.

[1/5] Plan: interactive keyboard controls, live telemetry HUD, new orbital choreographies, full test suite and remote push

impact_assessment.why: User requested all proposed features: real-time keyboard control during simulation, live telemetry charts, new choreographies, and remote publication.
impact_assessment.benefits: Transforms Orrery into an interactive terminal simulation toy with instant responsiveness, deep physical insight via live telemetry, and richer worlds.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: must preserve piped non-interactive CLI parity; dependency: strictly standard library only (msvcrt / select); concurrency: single-threaded non-blocking event loop; state: deterministic resets.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Wrap keyboard detection in a portable non-blocking reader that degrades gracefully to no-op when non-interactive or unsupported; ensure all tests pass in non-TTY environments.

[1/5] Plan: camera pan/zoom/body tracking, relativistic 1PN precession, collision coalescence mode, interactive scenario switching, and remote push

impact_assessment.why: User requested all proposed advanced capabilities: camera control and body tracking, 1PN general relativistic precession, inelastic merger collisions, and live scenario switching.
impact_assessment.benefits: Elevates Orrery into a full astronomical observatory: study orbits from rotating reference frames (e.g. geocentric epicycles), observe Mercury's precession, simulate planetary accretion, and switch worlds dynamically.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: default behaviour must remain unchanged; dependency: strictly standard library; concurrency: single-threaded event loop; state: merging modifies body array cleanly.
impact_assessment.mitigation: Opt-in flags (--relativity, --merge) preserve existing defaults; trail recorder handles dynamic body counts on merger; tests cover all new modes.
